summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV (formerly Galapagos NV) filed a Form 6-K with an attached press release dated September 8, 2026, reporting its repurchase of 132,014 own ordinary shares between August 31 and September 4, 2026, under its buyback program announced June 9, 2026. Shares were bought across Euronext Amsterdam and other trading venues via a discretionary mandate to an independent intermediary at an average price of €24.84, totaling €3,279,463.42, with prices ranging from €24.44 to €25.38. Following purchases, Lakefront held 1,293,338 treasury shares. This is a routine issuer share repurchase disclosure under a pre-existing program.
